title: ClinicRecord
description: Standard schema for importing verified real clinic and hospital facilities into MediSphere

name.description: Registered clinic, diagnostic center, or hospital facility name

address.description: Physical street address of facility. Use null if unconfirmed.

state.description: State where facility is located (e.g. 'Madhya Pradesh')

pincode.description: 6-digit postal code. Use null if unconfirmed.

phone.description: Official public telephone / contact number. Use null if unconfirmed.

website.description: Official public website URL. Use null if unavailable.

latitude.description: GPS latitude. Use null if unavailable.

longitude.description: GPS longitude. Use null if unavailable.

source.description: Verifiable public source of the facility information (e.g. Municipal Registry, Hospital Directory). REQUIRED for all imports.

verification_status.description: Verification state of the clinic facility. Never automatically verified.
